responsibility: Public declarations for RTL SSA instruction representation. This header defines insn_info, the note hierarchy attached to instructions, call-clobber notes and their splay tree, instruction ordering and range utilities, and the access, cost, and printing interfaces used by the RTL SSA function and block builders.
same_name_distinction: Defines the instruction-side data structures for RTL SSA—insn_info, insn_note kinds, call-clobber note/tree types, iterators, and insn_range_info—that insns.cc manipulates; unlike insns.cc, it establishes the representation and APIs for instruction ordering and attached notes rather than implementing their behavior.
